fact: A professor at the Bissau Faculty of Law, speaking at an ECOWAS Court conference in Dakar on 22 September 2026, said Guinea-Bissau does not yet have specific data protection legislation.
The same speaker said Guinea-Bissau has no dedicated national data protection authority, these matters being handled by several institutions sector by sector.

The speaker said a bill provides for creating a 'Data Protection Agency', with independence risks in its membership and in leaving its organisation to a decree; the article gives no stage for the bill.
system: Data protection bill (Agência de protecção de dados)

fact: Guinea-Bissau's national UPR report says the National People's Assembly's inaction blocks key legislation, and that several bills, including one on personal data protection, are awaiting discussion; no date is given, so the document's published date of 18 February 2025 is used.
